name: all-options
title: Every live option for Deidre
intro: Live switches: the Capability Statement card's drawing (?ridge=, 2026-11-13) and the Insights hero (?hero=, 2026-11-19), and the Insights phone cards (?rowcard=, 2026-11-19).

groups.heading: Capability Statement card: the drawing between the line and the codes
groups.intro: From 600px wide; phones have no room for it. Captured drawn and still (reduced motion).

options.label: Sketch
options.note: One full-height range closer to the owner's one-line reference (double foothill lines, curved face lines, a front ridge), drawn by the rust point, then the alpenglow.

options.label: Both
options.note: The layered ranges drawn back to front, then the alpenglow sweep along the near ridge (and faintly the middle one), leaving a warm edge on the summit.

options.label: Alpenglow
options.note: The one-line range drawn by the rust point, then a band of warm light sweeps along the ridge once and leaves a warm edge on the summit.

options.label: Layers
options.note: Three ranges in depth, drawn back to front; each hides the ones behind it and shifts with the card's turn.

groups.heading: Insights index: the hero
groups.intro: The top of /insights. Each is a whole desktop and phone version; the list below stays the same.

options.label: Current
options.note: The hero before this round at every width; still what phones and tablets see under the default.

options.label: Topics
options.note: The default (owner, 2026-11-19), desktop only: the four topics set large beside the headline with counts and arrows, the filter itself (after Claude's blog). Phones and tablets show the current hero.

options.label: Front page
options.note: After Mural, Webflow, and Twingate: the newest article large on the left and Latest (the next three) on the right, on the first screen.

options.label: Ask
options.note: After Airbnb's and Upwork's resource centers: a search over every article and its questions, and five questions buyers ask.

options.label: Plates
options.note: After Linear's and Slack's libraries: the line drawings of the six newest articles as a wall beside the headline.

groups.heading: Insights index on phones: the size of each card's drawing
groups.intro: Phones only (below 768px); the 1440 capture is the same for all three.

options.label: Compact
options.note: The row's own layout in a card: a 104px drawing beside the title, the summary and meta under them.

options.label: Band
options.note: The default (owner, 2026-11-19): a short strip of the drawing across the card's top (3:1, about 116px tall at 390), then the title, summary, and meta.

options.label: Side
options.note: The drawing beside the title grows to 150px (about 94px tall at 390), the summary and meta under them.
